items.title: Should You Sell Your Roblox Stock Now?
items.summary: Roblox (RBLX) holders have one worry: the stock has lost most of its value over the past year and may fall further. A $10,000 holding bought a year ago is worth about $3,170 today. The shares fell 9.9% on September 28, the day Roblox was downgraded to underperform by Jefferies. A fall this deep is worth holding through only if the business is still healthy. So is Roblox's business breaking, or are its players just spending less than the company expected.
